note: The voiceover script, one entry per line. 'say' is read by the voice (the brand is spelled 'Custom Domain' so it is read as two words; numbers are spelled out). 'gap' is the silence after the line in seconds. scripts/vo_build.py places the lines and writes their starts into timeline.json, so the picture is timed to the voice.

lines.say: This is the button that lets your customers connect their own domain.
It looks small. That's the part above the water.
Underneath, finding where each domain is managed, across a hundred and eighty-nine providers.
Signing in to them. O-Auth, Domain Connect, scoped A-P-I keys. A different door at almost every one.
For the hundred and sixteen with no door, a guided setup that checks every record by itself.
Root domains, which each provider handles its own way.
Checking every value until it resolves. Every five seconds at first, with a deadline.
Certificates, issued on the first visit, and renewed a month before they expire.
An edge that gets certificates for every customer's domain, and never for a host it shouldn't.
And every hour, checking that none of it has drifted.
That's what the button sits on. You could build all of it, and then run it, for as long as you have customers.
Or embed one widget, and leave the ice to us.
Custom Domain. You ship the button. We run everything under it.
